messages.productVision: Provide clear, helpful feedback when videos have no timeline comments, improving user understanding and reducing confusion in the Chzzk-to-YouTube timeline converter interface.

coreFeatures.name: Empty State Message Display
coreFeatures.description: Show a friendly message with icon when a video has zero timeline comments instead of displaying an empty comments area
acceptanceCriteria: Message displays: '이 영상에는 타임라인 댓글이 없습니다.'
ChatBubbleLeftIcon is shown prominently in the empty state
Message is styled consistently with existing EmptyState component pattern

coreFeatures.name: Educational Tip Text
coreFeatures.description: Provide contextual information about what timeline comments are to help users understand the feature
acceptanceCriteria: Tip text explains: '타임라인 댓글은 '0:00' 같은 시간 표시가 포함된 댓글입니다.'
Tip is displayed below the main empty state message
Tip text is visually de-emphasized (smaller font, lighter color)

coreFeatures.name: Theme Support
coreFeatures.description: Ensure empty state message works correctly in both light and dark themes
acceptanceCriteria: Text colors adapt to light mode (light-text)
Text colors adapt to dark mode (dark-text)
Background and borders follow existing theme patterns
Icon colors are appropriately styled for both themes

coreFeatures.name: Accessibility Support
coreFeatures.description: Ensure screen readers can properly announce the empty state
acceptanceCriteria: Empty state has appropriate ARIA labels
Icon has aria-hidden='true' since it's decorative
Message is announced by screen readers when displayed

userFlows.name: Viewing Video with No Timeline Comments
userFlows.description: User selects a video that has comments but none contain timestamps

steps.action: User clicks on a video in the left panel that shows '타임라인 0개'
steps.expectedResult: Video details load, comments section shows empty state with icon and message

steps.action: User reads the empty state message
steps.expectedResult: User understands why no comments are shown and what timeline comments are

steps.action: User toggles between light and dark mode
steps.expectedResult: Empty state message remains readable and properly styled in both themes

userFlows.name: Viewing Video After Timeline Comments Are Filtered Out
userFlows.description: User has conversion mode enabled but all timeline comments are filtered out

steps.action: User selects a video and enables '변환 보기' mode
steps.expectedResult: If no timeline comments exist, empty state displays instead of empty <pre> tag

steps.action: User sees the empty state with contextual message
steps.expectedResult: User understands there are no timeline comments to convert

requirements: Use existing EmptyState component pattern from ChzzkYoutubeConverterTab.tsx (lines 863-867)
Replace current empty <pre> tag display with EmptyState component when displayedComments.length === 0
Use ChatBubbleLeftIcon from @heroicons/react/24/outline (already imported at line 14)
Add educational tip text below the main message using consistent text styling
Ensure proper conditional rendering: only show when comments.length > 0 but displayedComments.length === 0
Follow existing color patterns: text-light-text/60 dark:text-dark-text/60 for secondary text
Maintain existing layout structure within the comments section div (lines 813-870)
Test with screen readers to ensure accessibility
Verify message displays correctly when toggling between original and converted comment views
Ensure the empty state does not appear when the entire comments section should be hidden (comments.length === 0)
